title: How to mount the Moza AB6 base without breaking it! 🛠️
description:
Setting up your new Moza AB6 Force Feedback flight base on a desk clamp? Make sure you watch out for that sensitive power plug! In this quick guide, I show you how to correctly align the multi-size screw holes (using one large and one small bolt), attach the base securely without stripping the hardware, and route the data cables cleanly through the integrated pass-through hole. Avoid the common assembly mistakes that can damage your flight sim setup!

Hardware Featured: Moza Flight AB6 FFB Base & Alloy Desk Mount
Software Context: Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 / MSFS 2020 / DCS World
